messages:
Maya (docs): Pushed a draft of the release notes for tomorrow's docs deploy: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/517. Main asks: concise "What's new" bullets, clear known-issue phrasing, and parity for SDK snippets across Python/Node/Go.

Jon S: Glanced through it. Two quick requests: 1) Make the Optimize entry explicit that batching is behind a beta flag; 2) add the Node streaming example (we only have Python right now).

Alesha: Also found a stale reference — the embeddings streaming deprecation note still links to the old /v1/embeds/stream path. Need to change to the unified embeddings flow and add a short migration tip.

Max G: I added a Node snippet consistent with SDK 2.x and fixed the await/stream loop. Snippet: ```js
const stream = await client.responses.stream({model: 'rw-infer-1', input: 'hi'});
for await (const part of stream) { process.stdout.write(part.text) }
```
Commit: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/commit/beefcafe

Maya (docs): Good. @Max G can you also add a 2-line callout under Known issues about tokenization differences when switching certain quantized model variants? We've had one customer ticket.

Max G: Will add q-model token boundary note + recommendation to re-run eval prompts.

Jon S: For the 'What's new' bullets, switch to metric-backed wording: e.g., "up to 3x throughput on short-chat workloads with intelligent batching (measured on rw-infer-1, 0.5s median latency)". Avoid marketing adjectives.

Alesha: I can fix the redirect that 301s to preview. The broken links I saw: /docs/guides/streaming, /docs/sdk/node/examples, /docs/release-notes/previous. I'll open a redirect-fix PR and point to canonical paths.

Maya (docs): Assigning: @Max G update Node + q-note; @Alesha redirect PR; @Jon S reword bullets. I'll fold changes into the main PR and trigger preview.

deploy-bot: Preview build: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/changes/517 (expires in 72h).

Jon S: Tiny markdown nit — one code fence in the preview renders raw (missing trailing newline). I'll drop a patch in the PR comment.

Maya (docs): If we can get these in by EOD I can merge and schedule deploy tomorrow AM. Otherwise we'll gate the Optimize beta mention behind a follow-up note. :thumbsup:
